spec_match.rationale: Concepts map the proposal's exact semantics from the explainer: the on-prefetch-activation response header with a relative endpoint reference that resolves same-origin (header concept), the proposed browser-dispatched credentialless HEAD after commit (request properties previewed, never fired), real speculation-rules prefetch + deliveryType-observed prefetch consumption (prefetch/target pair), and the three client-side failure modes the explainer lists (gaps). Distinctions preserved throughout: ordinary prefetch vs speculation-rules prefetch vs activation-at-commit vs request/response vs server observation vs what a client-only page cannot prove.

interactive.rationale: Real visible controls everywhere: rule injection + gated navigation link, navigation-timing re-read, header/rules/beacon builder with live same-origin validation, and lifecycle-event-driven drift counters. Nothing fires automatically.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index and ledes now label response-header → credentialless HEAD behavior as proposal/origin-trial semantics, not behavior proven by these static pages. They distinguish browser-generated/non-interceptable-by-page-script design claims from server evidence. The header concept's enablement copy is now exact: origin trial desktop 151–155 (registerable, origin_trial_id 3433431765916581889), runtime feature PrefetchAndPrerenderActivationBeacon (status experimental, public — so chrome://flags/#prefetch-and-prerender-activation-beacon or --enable-blink-features=PrefetchAndPrerenderActivationBeacon; the prior --enable-features=PrefetchActivationBeacon and #prefetch-activation-beacon names were wrong).

edge_cases.rationale: Absolute and protocol-relative endpoint values are rejected because the proposal requires a relative reference, which must also resolve same-origin with the final prefetched response; normal navigation is distinguished from prefetch consumption via deliveryType ('' ≠ 'navigational-prefetch'). The client-gaps page treats pageshow/visibility events as real lifecycle inputs but labels its one-activation truth count as a fixed reference scenario. BFCache restoration is separated from a new prefetch activation, and neither activation nor beacon dispatch is inferred from request completion or deliveryType alone.

references.rationale: All pages cite chromestatus.com/feature/5118934710878208 and the explainer; the index also links MDN's Speculation Rules API and deliveryType page (verified 200). MDN/BCD exactness recorded: no MDN page or BCD record exists for the on-prefetch-activation header itself (both 404, checked 2026-07-24).

conformance.rationale: New immutable root suite (this cycle, 8 assertions — 8 JSON entries = 8 rendered rows = 8 reported): prerequisite/adjacent observable hosts only — speculation-rules support and navigation-timing deliveryType — plus the absence of a proposed Document/Navigator member. All 8 pass on Chrome 150, but the descriptions explicitly state that this does NOT test the response header, post-commit HEAD dispatch, credential mode, interception rules, or server receipt; those remain unexecuted until a real header/endpoint environment exists.

runtime_evidence.rationale: chrome-devtools-mcp on HeadlessChrome/150 (2026-07-24): all visible controls exercised at 1280×800 and 390×844 with post-interaction geometry — rule injection + link activation + real navigation to the target (deliveryType observed as normal-navigation honestly on first load), header builder relative/same-origin accept + absolute/cross-origin reject, drift counters via visibility events, and the sendBeacon PREVIEW (no network request fired — verified in the network log), zero console errors, zero failed requests.

telemetry_health.rationale: Concepts emit showcaseTelemetry.assert events per branch (sr-detected, rule-injected, target-activated/normal/no-deliverytype, endpoint relative/same-origin or invalid-reference, client-signal-fired, manual-sendbeacon-previewed); telemetry POSTs returned 202 during validation.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout, button background+color pairs, focus-visible styles, no static-card pattern; edits were copy/JS-logic level and preserve layout.

accessibility.rationale: role=status/aria-live on banners, verdicts, counters, and logs; the navigation link uses aria-disabled until the prefetch exists; buttons are native and keyboard-operable.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Matrix pass including post-interaction states: all five pages scrollWidth equals viewport at 1280×800 and 390×844 after every control (rule injection, builder input, counter increments).

openQuestions.title: Exercise the real beacon end-to-end with a server route under the origin trial
openQuestions.detail: The family deliberately ships no server route (static demo files cannot emit response headers, and no real beacon may fire). The header concept carries a maintainer TODO for a /prefetched route (emits on-prefetch-activation: ./beacon) and a /beacon route (logs the HEAD). Only implement when the origin trial (desktop 151–155, origin_trial_id 3433431765916581889) or the PrefetchAndPrerenderActivationBeacon runtime feature can be enabled in the test environment, and re-verify: relative endpoint parsing against the final response URL, HEAD method through redirects, credentialless mode, same-origin enforcement, one-time referrer-bound dispatch, and no service-worker interception.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region announcements for dynamic probe/status results after button activation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce dynamic state through live regions tied to the activating control; keep programmatic names on status surfaces.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verified applied: banners/verdicts/counters/logs use role=status or role=log with aria-live; the gated navigation link exposes aria-disabled.

guidanceConsulted.query: telemetry beacon design that avoids new tracking vectors and fires no automatic requests
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Avoid automatic network beacons; require explicit user initiation; make the destination explicit; never leak dynamic client state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied strictly: the family fires NO real beacon — the client-side-gaps demo's sendBeacon is now a previewed call that is never sent (previously it fired at a dead route, fixed), and the header concept validates author-controlled header/endpoint inputs and previews proposed request properties but never dispatches a request. Parent review also enforced the explainer's relative endpoint syntax, generated the actual absolute target URL in the speculation rule, removed an unsupported Sec-Fetch-Mode header from the preview, and separated deliveryType evidence from server-beacon proof.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: chrome-devtools-mcp network log after every control: zero beacon/404 requests

summary: Source-review of the Prefetch activation beacon family against the explainer (on-prefetch-activation response header → credentialless HEAD at commit; same-origin endpoint; one-time referrer-bound; no SW/JS/extension interception; legacy link-prefetch and subresources are non-goals), the direct chromestatus detail (updated 2026-07-13: v151 listing Origin trial; OT desktop 151–155 with origin_trial_id 3433431765916581889; ship unset, 'Proposed'), the runtime feature (PrefetchAndPrerenderActivationBeacon, experimental, public), and exact MDN/BCD (no header record anywhere). The family required stronger evidence boundaries in addition to two concrete defects: deliveryType proves prefetch consumption but not beacon dispatch; the header builder is a request-shape preview rather than an exact observed request; and the client drift counter is a fixed scenario compared with real lifecycle events, not measured ground truth. Fixed the concrete defects: the client-side-gaps demo actually fired a sendBeacon at a dead route (now a preview that is never sent, button relabelled), and the header concept's flag instructions named a nonexistent feature (now PrefetchAndPrerenderActivationBeacon + the public chrome://flags kebab name + registerable OT). Parent review additionally enforced relative endpoint syntax, fixed the speculation-rule target URL, removed an unsupported preview header, labelled lifecycle counters as scenario-versus-observation, and removed deliveryType→beacon proof claims. Added the immutable root suite (8 prerequisite/adjacent assertions plus a negative common-host check; all pass, while direct server behavior remains unexecuted). Missing-suite denominator 8→7 expected (791/798).
